content.heading: Every AI provider and tool that may touch your data.
content.lead: We call them subprocessors: the companies whose AI models and software we use to do your work. Each one is listed here with what it does, which of your data it may see and where it runs.
body: Alert (Info): Published before launch. We publish the full list before the site goes live. Until then, every row on this page is a placeholder.

content.heading: When this list changes, you hear first.
content.lead: We tell partners before a new subprocessor starts working with their data.

items.title: We email you first.
items.text: The contact on your account hears from us [notice period] before a new subprocessor starts, with who it is, what it does and why.

items.title: You can ask or object.
items.text: Reply with questions or concerns, and we'll answer before the change goes ahead.

items.title: We update this page.
items.text: The change appears here, with its date, on the day it takes effect.
